The intrusive UA_SessionHeader list entry is inserted twice, corrupting the channel sessions list. Session removal detaches once, delayed destruction frees the session, and later UA_SecureChannel_deleteMembersCleanup traverses the stale list entry and causes a heap-use-after-free. I have observed Service_ActivateSession lines 267-275 only detach when the existing channel differs and then unconditionally attach. A reference search found the attach function is only called from Service_ActivateSession, but I want to preserve valid reactivation and channel transfer semantics and choose the strongest invariant-enforcing location.

I tried making attach idempotent, also skipping attach in the service, and defensive cycle repair in detach, but the test system continues reporting the original UAF.
